text:
Ravi: OK team, rainy day checklist: tunes/picks for a 30min walk? low-energy, cozy, or weirdly uplifting recs welcome.
June: Love this. Suggestion: Mitski 1
Lena: haha silent 1-word review? :stuck_out_tongue: also! short film rec: 'Piper' (Pixar, ~6m) if you want cute + fast.
Ravi: Nice, adding Piper. For albums: Norah Jones 'Come Away With Me' fits the vibe.
June: For something off-beat but kind, try Sufjan Stevens 'Carrie & Lowell' (quiet, tender).
Lena: If you want instrumental: Balmorhea or Olafur Arnalds for a soft, textural walk.
Ravi: Quick book rec for commute reading: 'The Housekeeper and the Professor' 1 friendly, short, mathematically charming.
June: Also, guilty pleasure rewatch rec: 'The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel' season 1 binge if you have an hour. Bright and quick.
BuildBot: Reminder: All-hands music share channel created at #all-hands-music.
Lena: Poll: which to do at 3pm break? 1) Short film (Piper) 2) Album swap 3) Quiet reading circle (15m)
June: 1
Ravi: 2
Lena: 1
June: Also throwing in a micro-meme: "rainy day soundtrack = puddle remix" :umbrella:
Ravi: I'll bring instant coffee and a tiny speaker. June, want to curate the album swap?
June: Yep, happy to. Will add a 10-track limit so it's quick.
Lena: I'll bring my copy of Housekeeper to swap.
Ravi: Perf. See y'all at 3. Tiny note: remember to RSVP in the break event so we don't overstuff the room.
BuildBot: Event updated: Breakroom booked 15:00-15:30.
June: Score. Also adding a shared playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/placeholder-wet-walks
Lena: Thanks everyone! Also congrats to @Ravi for not getting soaked today. :tada:
Ravi: victory! :sweat_smile:
